reason: I always forget pills at home and I travel a lot, so a daily sachet I can throw in my bag is actually the first version of this I would stick with. The $24.99 launch price makes it an easy one-box try.
objection: Two capsules every day is still a chore, and I know I will skip days. I will only buy one box and see if I actually use it. Not paying $30 a month for something sitting in a drawer.
